transcript.text: I'd like you to make a sneaker ad, and I don't have a photo, so please generate a plain white leather low-top sneaker with white laces, a white sole, and no logo. I've been thinking about this little ad for a while and am excited to see it come together. What I need is a silent 15-second 9:16 video with three moving shots of the product. The captions should appear in this exact order: “Meet your everyday pair”, then “Clean look. Easy style.”, then “Shop now”. My main worry is that reel buttons might cover the words when someone watches it. Please keep every caption, including its full text bounds, at least 15% in from either side and 20% from the top and bottom so those buttons won't cover them.

I've made the sneaker picture to base the ad on: a plain white leather low-top with white laces, a white sole and no logo:
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbib4nf052df101lwr72469/output.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T023532Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

The plan is three 5-second moving shots, joined in a 15 s silent 9:16 video:
1. A slow orbit around the sneaker
2. A close glide along the laces and leather
3. A wide pull-back while the shoe turns on a turntable

I need you to pick one thing before I make the video (the 3 clips cost 360 credits). None of my tools let me place text by exact position, so I can't promise the 15% side / 20% top-and-bottom margins. Here are the two options I have for the captions:

A) Caption cards: after each shot comes a short plain card (about 2 s, taken from that shot's time) with the caption drawn in the middle. The spelling is always exact, and short centred lines like these should sit well inside your safe zone. The catch: the words show between the shots, not on top of them.

B) Captions on the shots: the video model writes each caption right onto its moving shot. This looks most like a real ad, but the model decides where the words go and how big they are, and the spelling isn't guaranteed. The words could end up in the button area.

Since keeping the words clear of the reel buttons matters most to you, I'd go with A. Which do you want? If you choose A, you can also give me a card colour (e.g. white, black or a hex code).
transcript.why: The reply shows a finished sneaker image, but it ends by asking the user to choose caption option A or B and waits for that choice. Its main action is a request for a choice, so it is a question.

transcript.text: I'll go with A, since keeping the words clear of the reel buttons is what matters most to me. I don't have a card colour in mind, so please choose one that is easy to read on a phone. Also, the captions are just three short lines, and they need to stay in this exact order: "Meet your everyday pair", "Clean look. Easy style.", "Shop now".

Your sneaker ad is done. Download it here:
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/11b3ca87fd214c7d91005c3c1249000c.mp4

What's in it (15 s, 9:16 at 480×858, silent):
1. 0–3 s: a slow orbit around the white sneaker
2. 3–5 s: card "Meet your everyday pair"
3. 5–8 s: a close glide along the laces and leather
4. 8–10 s: card "Clean look. Easy style."
5. 10–13 s: a wide pull-back as the shoe turns on a turntable
6. 13–15 s: card "Shop now"

For the cards I chose a near-black background (#111111) with white text, since it reads best on a phone. Each caption is drawn in code, centred on its own card, so the spelling and order are exact.

What I checked and what I didn't:
- Checked: the length, the 9:16 size, no sound, and each card lasting 2 s.
- Not checked: I can't look at the frames myself, so I haven't measured the text against your 15% side and 20% top/bottom margins. These are short centred lines, so they should sit well inside, but please scrub through the cards to confirm. "Clean look. Easy style." is the widest line.
- Also not checked: whether the shoe looks the same in all three shots, and that it shows no logo in any of them. The video model used the sneaker picture as a guide, so small differences between shots are possible.

Cost: 216 credits for the three shots plus 5 for the sneaker picture. A first try at the shots failed on a broken picture link and charged nothing.

If any card or shot needs a change, tell me which one and I'll redo only that part.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a download link to the rendered 15-second video, with a shot-by-shot breakdown. It includes caveats (unchecked text margins, shoe consistency, logo visibility) and a cost note, but it does not ask for approval or a choice before proceeding. The offer to redo a shot is a follow-up option, not a pending request.
